experiment_data.hypothesis: Post-hoc Type Consistency Resolution (TCR) can reduce CF violations by ≥30% in zero-shot and ≥50% in LoRA settings without increasing DR, by resolving cross-triple entity type conflicts using global relation constraint satisfaction scoring. During-decoding consensus failed (100% skip rate) due to lack of global information; post-hoc TCR has full document context and should succeed where per-token approaches cannot.
